name: Neon Outline
description: In a dark warehouse the subject is traced in glowing neon tubes and becomes pure light.

wardrobe.man: a black hoodie and black trousers
wardrobe.woman: a black hoodie and black trousers
wardrobe.person: a black hoodie and black trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands in the middle of a dark empty warehouse at night, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, hands relaxed. A thin haze fills the space, faint blue light leaks through high windows, and the concrete floor is wet and reflective. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered, full body visible, darkness around. Cinematic low-key photography, faint cold blue backlight, deep blacks. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, bare concrete walls throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in the dark warehouse, eyes on a point just past the camera. Glowing neon tubes draw themselves along {their} outline, a bright magenta line tracing the silhouette from the head down to the feet and cyan lines tracing the face, the hair and the folds of the clothes, until the {subject} is a figure drawn in glowing neon light that lights up the haze and reflects in the wet floor, while the body inside the lines fades into darkness; the neon figure turns its head toward the camera. The camera pushes in slowly. Sound: an electric neon buzz rising, a soft crackle as each tube lights, a low humming bass. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, glowing neon tubes with real light spill and reflections, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. Glowing neon tubes draw themselves along the outline of the {subject}, magenta along the silhouette and cyan along the face, the hair and the folds of the clothes, until the {subject} is a figure drawn in glowing neon light, while the body inside the lines fades into darkness. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: an electric neon buzz rising, soft crackles as each tube lights. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, glowing neon tubes with real light spill, sharp detail, stable picture.
